moments.selftext: Dear Hindus, I knew very little about your religion. I was so immersed in studying the Abrahamic faiths because I’m insanely in love with the Holy Bible that I never gave myself enough time to learn about Hinduism. But through my friendship with the Hindu community in the UAE, I have encountered something that means a great deal to me: a profound respect for human life, coexistence, and building together. That alone is enough for me to approach you with respect and a genuine desire to learn more. The God I believe in is the God of Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, and Jacob, the God whom the prophets called the God of Israel. Israel was the personal name given to Jacob in the biblical tradition by my Creator, and his descendants became known as the Children of Israel. The Jewish people trace their identity and history through this ancient Israelite heritage and their deep connection to the Land of Israel, including Judea. And I believe my Creator wants us to work together around what we share rather than kill one another over where we differ. We can thrive together. We can build together. We can prosper together. God will judge us when we die. Until then, we have been given this beautiful planet and the opportunity to know one another, help one another, and as Michael Jackson so beautifully urged humanity to heal the world and make it a better place. As a proud friend of the Hindu community in the UAE, I wish you nothing but the best. I hope we continue building together, investing together in AI and high tech, advancing science and innovation, and making our beloved UAE as close to heaven on Earth as human beings can make it. This is what I believe my God and Creator, the God of Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, and Jacob wants from me. And I will do my best to fulfill it.
